name: Candi Nguyen
source:
With bubblegum pink hair and an infectious smile, Candi is the kind of person who lights up a room just by walking in. Carefree, charming, and impossible to ignore, she radiates a happy-go-lucky attitude that makes it easy to assume she doesn’t have a care in the world.

But there’s something mysterious about Candi, something just beneath the surface. Her intuition is uncanny, almost supernatural, and when danger lurks in the shadows of Bear Ridge, her gut feelings might be the only thing keeping Jenny alive. And if survival wasn’t complicated enough, Jenny and Candi find themselves entangled in a fake dating scheme, pretending to be in love for all the wrong reasons. But as the lines between pretend and real start to blur, Jenny might realize that Candi’s not just her fake girlfriend, but the one person she can truly trust.
